message: 仲良きことは

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Hello, Nanaka-san」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, Fuyuka-san. Hello」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been a while. Thank you for your help during Kirafes.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「There is no need to thank me. I gained quite a lot from it as well. Especially from Nanaka-san.」
She must mean back then.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, no, it's really nothing worth bringing up so formally……」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「That is not true at all. It is rare to meet someone who loves sweets as deeply as you do.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, please don't tease me too much. I only…… just eat them……」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Didn't you say it yourself, Nanaka-san? That taste is everything when it comes to sweets.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I said all sorts of cheeky things back then…… just remembering it makes me embarrassed」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「No, it wasn't cheeky at all. What you said was completely right, and yet it is something we makers often tend to forget.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Sweets have no meaning without someone to savor them. So you mustn't say that you 'just' eat them.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「After all, we are the two wings that carry sweets to even greater heights.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man…… ahaha」
Nanaka scratched her head bashfully.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm glad. It looks like you two have become great friends.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Well, we are fellow sweets lovers, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Love for sweets knows no borders!」

name: Synn
message: 「Does Nanaka visit your shop often?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Personally, I wish she would drop by a little more frequently. I would gladly treat her, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, I'm strictly a customer, so I couldn't possibly not pay」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You really don't need to hold back like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's only natural as a customer.」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「You should just come by as a friend. Didn't the two of us go sweets-hopping the other day and exchange email addresses too?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That and this are two different things, after all」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Still, I quite admire that kind of unwavering resolve」

name: Synn
message: 「That's so like you, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Nanaka-san. Let's go food-hopping again sometime. Of course, please do visit my shop as well. You are welcome anytime」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even have to ask, I'd love to」
Fuyuka-san glanced over at me and

name: Fuyuka
message: 「When you do, please bring your boyfriend along. It'll be my treat」
